title: BuddyMod
description: Client-side friend manager: animated GUI, secret chat, player notes, and nametag customization.
body:
![cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9734d9e869ff2dd194c5e67cccd06c1149e2e60e.png)
![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bdb9264e43d6abd428f12f02cb1a1bccbe8c9fc.png)

## ✅ Features:
- **Animated GUI (Key 'K'):** A beautifully designed, fully animated menu with tabs for Friends, Incoming, and Outgoing requests.
  
- **Secret P2P Messenger:** Chat privately with other BuddyMod users. Your messages are encrypted and completely hidden from the server chat and server logs!
  
- **Player Dossier & Notes:** The mod automatically remembers the Date and Server IP where you first met a player. Leave multi-line custom notes for every friend.
  
- **Deep Customization:** Change your friends' nametag colors using a built-in color picker with a live 3D character preview. Friends are also highlighted with a golden star (⭐) in the Tab list.
  
- **Smart Notifications:** Beautiful, customizable on-screen pop-ups for logins, messages, and friend requests.
  
![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bdb9264e43d6abd428f12f02cb1a1bccbe8c9fc.png)
## ⚙️ Compatibility
BuddyMod is **100% Client-Side**. 
This means you can use it on **ANY** server (Hypixel, 2b2t, Aternos, realms, or local worlds). The server does not need to have this mod installed.
*To use the Secret Chat feature, both you and your friend must have the mod installed.*

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bdb9264e43d6abd428f12f02cb1a1bccbe8c9fc.png)
